seo.title: Kemnaker Work-at-Height Certification: TKPK & TKBT | RAC
seo.description: How Kemnaker work-at-height certification works: TKPK Levels 1–3 (rope access), TKBT Levels 1–2 (high structures), prerequisites, and verification.

hero.title: Official Certificates from Kemnaker RI
hero.body: Every RAC programme uses the Ministry of Manpower’s work-at-height certification scheme, under Regulation 9/2016.

sections.body:
## One scheme: Kemnaker RI

[Ministry of Manpower Regulation 9/2016](https://jdih.kemnaker.go.id/peraturan/detail/1210/peraturan-menteri-ketenagakerjaan-nomor-9-tahun-2016) on safety in work at height requires such work to be carried out by competent workers. Every RAC programme closes with a competency test under Kemnaker rules, and successful candidates receive a competency certificate and K3 licence for their grade.

## TKPK: work at height (rope access)

TKPK is the scheme for rope access work, in three grades:

- **[Level 1](/en/tkpk-level-1-training/)** — technicians working under supervision.
- **[Level 2](/en/tkpk-level-2-training/)** — rig anchor systems, perform advanced rescues, and supervise Level 1.
- **[Level 3](/en/tkpk-level-3-training/)** — supervisors who plan the work, write rescue plans, and lead the team.

## TKBT: high-structure work

TKBT is the scheme for work done by climbing structures — towers, steel frames, scaffolds — using fall arrest. [Level 1](/en/tkbt-level-1-training/) is for workers under supervision, [Level 2](/en/tkbt-level-2-training/) for independent workers and supervisors.

## Choosing between TKPK and TKBT

If your work hangs on a rope — façades, tank walls, chimney sides — you need TKPK. If you climb and move on a structure with lanyards — towers, frames, scaffolds — you need TKBT. We go into detail in [TKPK or TKBT?](/en/choosing-rope-access-certification/).

## Validity and verification

Validity, renewal, and verification follow current Kemnaker rules. We help trainees prepare enrolment and renewal paperwork, and we encourage every employer to verify certificates directly with the issuer.

Want to know how we prepare candidates? Read [our profile and values](/en/about-us/), or [contact us](/en/contact/) about requirements.

sections.title: Kemnaker certification grades for work at height
sections.intro: A summary of each grade’s role and main prerequisites. Final requirements follow current Kemnaker rules.
rows: Rope access technician working under supervision
Age 18+, medically fit, no experience needed
Rigs anchor systems, advanced rescue, supervises Level 1
Supervisor: work plans, rescue plans, team leadership
TKPK 1 & 2, senior secondary education, age 22+, experience (typically 1,000+ hours), first aid
Climbs and works on structures using fall arrest
Age 18+, medically fit, no experience needed
Works independently and supervises teams on high structures
TKBT 1 + experience of work at height
sections.note: TKPK = Tenaga Kerja pada Ketinggian (rope access). TKBT = Tenaga Kerja Bangunan Tinggi (climbing structures with fall arrest).
